summary.problem: When running in ACP server mode (gemini --acp), token usage reported in PromptResponse omits cached and thought tokens from Gemini usageMetadata, causing ACP clients to overestimate costs.
summary.root_cause: In packages/cli/src/acp/acpSession.ts, the GeminiEventType.Finished handler only extracts promptTokenCount and candidatesTokenCount from usageMetadata, ignoring cachedContentTokenCount and thoughtsTokenCount. Additionally, the standard ACP PromptResponse.usage field is not populated with these values.
summary.context: Gemini API returns cachedContentTokenCount and thoughtsTokenCount in usageMetadata. ACP standard usage schema supports inputTokens, outputTokens, cachedReadTokens, thoughtTokens, and totalTokens.

steps: In packages/cli/src/acp/acpSession.ts, initialize variables totalCachedReadTokens and totalThoughtTokens alongside totalInputTokens and totalOutputTokens in the prompt method.
In the turn loop of prompt, initialize turnCachedReadTokens and turnThoughtTokens alongside turnInputTokens and turnOutputTokens.
Update the GeminiEventType.Finished event handler in acpSession.ts to extract usage.cachedContentTokenCount into turnCachedReadTokens and usage.thoughtsTokenCount into turnThoughtTokens.
Accumulate turnCachedReadTokens and turnThoughtTokens into totalCachedReadTokens and totalThoughtTokens at the end of each turn.
Populate the standard ACP usage field in PromptResponse returns with inputTokens, outputTokens, cachedReadTokens, thoughtTokens, and totalTokens.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When a prompt turn completes, PromptResponse.usage includes cachedReadTokens and thoughtTokens populated from usageMetadata.cachedContentTokenCount and usageMetadata.thoughtsTokenCount.
verification_steps: Update mock stream responses in packages/cli/src/acp/acpSession.test.ts to include cachedContentTokenCount and thoughtsTokenCount in usageMetadata.
Add test assertions verifying that calling session.prompt() returns a response containing usage with correct inputTokens, outputTokens, cachedReadTokens, thoughtTokens, and totalTokens values.

github_metadata.title: ACP: PromptResponse usage omits cached/thought tokens, inflating client cost estimates
